Repo: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa, branch feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component.

Re-score Step 2 (ZimmSizeChip + ZimmSizeChipGroup) — round 2, after rework. Verify the 3 authorized fixes landed correctly; this is a bounded rework, not a fresh audit.

## Round 1 required exactly 3 fixes:
1. `zimmSizeChipGroup/index.test.tsx` — tautological `toHaveTextContent('S')` → `toHaveAttribute('data-size-value', 's')`.
2. `zimmSizeChip.css.ts` — export the 3 colour resolvers + new `zimmSizeChip.css.test.ts` mirroring `zimmTextInput.css.test.ts`, covering precedence including the `{selected:true, disabled:true}` case.
3. `zimmSizeChip.css.ts` lines ~15/21 — wrong-token-category swap: `text-default` → `border-focus` (border) and `text-default` → `bg-05` (background), zero-visual-diff.

Explicitly deferred to Marcel (not this round): missing i18n extraction (translations/*.json untouched, correctly).

## Implementer's round-2 report claims:
- Fix 1: applied exactly as specified, re-mutation-tested (temporarily broke `firstEnabledIndex`, confirmed the specific test now fails, reverted, confirmed passes).
- Fix 2: both resolvers exported, new `zimmSizeChip.css.test.ts` created with 14 tests (4 per resolver × 3 resolvers + 2 recipe-wiring tests), mirroring `zimmTextInput.css.test.ts`. Re-mutation-tested (inverted `resolveTextColour`'s precedence, confirmed exactly one new test fails with the right expected-vs-received values, reverted, confirmed 14/14 pass).
- Fix 3: both lines changed exactly as specified, `resolveTextColour` and all other branches left untouched.
- Full suite: 49 files / 736 tests, all pass. tsc/eslint/audit:tokens all clean, only the pre-existing unrelated footer.css.ts:20 finding.
- No translations/*.json touched, no other component touched.
- **Implementer flagged one thing without changing it**: `zimmSizeChip.css.ts`'s doc comment (lines ~42-46) still describes the selected-state colour as "a text-default fill" — now stale/inaccurate after Fix 3 correctly moved the code to `border-focus`/`bg-05`. Implementer left it because the round's instructions named only lines 15/21 and said leave "every other branch" untouched, and didn't want to unilaterally expand the edit.

## Your job
1. Read the actual current content of all 3 touched locations plus the new test file — confirm claims are literally true, not just asserted.
2. Re-run verification yourself:
```
npx tsc --noEmit
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts
npx vitest run overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts
npx eslint overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup
node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs
git status --porcelain
git diff --stat
```
3. Read the new `zimmSizeChip.css.test.ts` in full — does it genuinely cover the precedence cases (especially the `{selected:true, disabled:true}` case for all three resolvers, not just resolveTextColour), or did the Implementer only cover the one resolver the example mutation targeted? This matters: the original defect was "ALL THREE resolvers are untested," not just resolveTextColour.
4. Decide on the flagged stale doc comment: is this worth requiring a fix (1-line, same file already being edited this round, improves accuracy) or genuinely out of round-2's bounded scope? Your call.
5. Confirm scope is still exactly: the 3 fix locations + 1 new test file, nothing else, and the running Tier 2 registration total is unaffected (no new theme/components/index.ts changes this round).

Give PASS or REWORK (round 2 of 3 max, so this is the last round before an automatic escalation to Marcel if it fails again).

# Round 2 Re-Score — ZimmSizeChip + ZimmSizeChipGroup (SFCC-236)

## Per-axis verdict

| Axis | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **Design fidelity** | PASS — carried forward, provably unaffected | Fix 3's token swap is genuinely zero-visual-diff: `text.default`, `background['05']`, and `border.focus` all alias to the identical primitive `grey[900]` (`overrides/app/theme/foundation/colour.ts:55,61,74`). Fixes 1–2 touch only test files. Nothing rendered changed this round. I did not run a fresh screenshot-vs-Figma comparison this round — see "What I could not verify." |
| **Completeness** | PASS, with a low-severity note | All 3 ACs met with story/test present. While reading the full test file for Fix 1 I found a **second, pre-existing** instance of the same substring-matching weakness at `zimmSizeChipGroup/index.test.tsx:125` (`toHaveTextContent('S')` — independently confirmed via a live matcher check that this also matches literal text "XS"). Not part of round 1's named defect or round 2's scope, and not load-bearing on its own — line 126 in the same test independently re-verifies the same fact with an exact-match assertion. |
| **Restraint** | PASS | `git status`/`git diff --stat` show exactly the pre-existing 4-line `theme/components/index.ts` registration diff (unchanged this round) plus the two untracked component directories — nothing else in the repo is dirty, no translations touched. The Implementer correctly declined to expand the doc-comment fix beyond the named lines 15/21 and flagged it transparently instead of unilaterally editing or silently ignoring it — that's the right call, not a restraint failure. |
| **Conformance** | PASS | Every `var(--zimm-*)` reference in `zimmSizeChip.css.ts` resolves to a real token (checked against `zimmTokens.ts`). `recipeGuards.test.ts` (bare-token guard) and `recipeParts.test.ts` both green. `audit:tokens` shows zero new findings — only the pre-existing, unrelated `footer.css.ts:20` item. |
| **Correctness** | PASS | `tsc --noEmit` clean. `eslint` clean (confirmed exit code 0, not just empty output). Full suite: 49/49 files, 736/736 tests green on my own re-run — matches the claim exactly. |
| **Pass criteria** | PASS | All 3 round-1 fixes independently reproduced from source, not taken on the Implementer's word — detail below. |

## Overall: PASS

This closes the loop for Step 2 — no third round needed.

## What I tried to falsify

- **Fix 1** (tautological assertion): read the current `zimmSizeChipGroup/index.test.tsx:102` — confirmed it now reads `expect(stops[0]).toHaveAttribute('data-size-value', 's')`. Then independently mutated `firstEnabledIndex` in `index.tsx` (made it ignore `isDisabled` entirely) and re-ran the suite: exactly the named test failed (`data-size-value="xs"` received vs `"s"` expected), plus one other pre-existing test caught it too. Reverted and confirmed byte-identical to the backup and 43/43 green again.
- **Fix 2** (resolver export + coverage): read `zimmSizeChip.css.test.ts` in full. Rather than trust the Implementer's report that only `resolveTextColour` was mutation-tested, I independently mutated **all three** resolvers' precedence order one at a time (`resolveBorderColour`, `resolveBackgroundColour`, then `resolveTextColour` myself as a third check) and re-ran the file after each: each mutation produced exactly one failing test with the correct expected-vs-received values, isolated to that resolver's own "disabled wins over selected" case. Reverted each time and diffed against a backup to confirm exact restoration.
- **Fix 3** (token-category swap, "zero-visual-diff" claim): didn't take this on faith — traced `border-focus`, `bg-05`, and `text-default` back through `colour.ts` and confirmed all three alias to the same primitive (`grey[900]`), which is what makes the fix genuinely invisible on screen.
- **Scope creep**: `git status --porcelain`, `git diff --stat`, and file-mtime forensics (`stat -f %Sm`) across every file in both component folders — the only files with a post-baseline mtime are exactly the 3 claimed touch points, plus `zimmSizeChipGroup/index.tsx` itself (explained by the Implementer's own reported mutate→test→revert cycle for Fix 1's mutation testing, which I confirmed leaves the file byte-identical to expectation).
- **A second latent tautology**: while reading the group's test file end-to-end (not just the named line), spotted `toHaveTextContent('S')` at line 125 and didn't assume jest-dom's matching semantics — wrote a throwaway test inside the discoverable `overrides/**/*.test.tsx` path proving `toHaveTextContent('S')` passes against literal text "XS" in this project's actual setup, then deleted it and confirmed via `git status` it left no trace.

## What I could not verify

- **No fresh Figma/screenshot comparison** against the named nodes (`40003038:125876` for the atom, `40003066:34868` for the group) was performed this round. I have strong indirect proof round 2 didn't change anything visual (the token-alias identity above), but I did not independently re-confirm round 1's design-fidelity assessment from scratch — treating that as carried forward, not re-audited.
- **No git history exists for either component directory** (`git status` shows both fully untracked) — I could not diff against a literal "round 1" commit. I substituted mtime forensics plus full-content reproduction of every claimed behavior, which is why the mutation testing above was done from scratch rather than inferred from a diff.

## Defects (both non-blocking — noted, not required for this round's PASS)

- **`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip/zimmSizeChip.css.ts:41-42`** — LOW, CONFIRMED. Doc comment still reads "a text-default fill for the selected state," which Fix 3 correctly replaced with `border-focus`/`bg-05`. This is the same comment that asks a UI designer to "flag ... if it doesn't match" — so leaving it stale means a future reviewer checks the description against the wrong implementation. Instruction: reword to describe a border-focus outline / bg-05 fill for the selected state. Trivial, same file, fine to fold in whenever this file is next opened — not worth spending this step's last round on.
- **`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup/index.test.tsx:125`** — LOW, CONFIRMED (reproduced live, see above).
